reported.quote: The revenue from operations as disclosed earlier is INR49,533 crores, delivered in the stand-alone business.

We opened 1.8 million square feet area in the current year.

business: Avenue Supermarts Limited operates hypermarkets under the brand name DMart, offering a wide range of food, non-food FMCG, general merchandise, and apparel products. The company also runs an e-commerce business under DMart Ready, providing home delivery and pick-up services for grocery and daily essentials.
